sql:
SELECT
  event_name,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS distinct_user_count
FROM events
WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY event_name
ORDER BY event_count DESC, event_name ASC
LIMIT 30
note: Platform-wide, unfiltered inventory of all distinct event_name values in 2025 with their counts, as requested, so the analyst can visually identify KB/article/help-view events; the printed report will show the total distinct event_name count alongside the top-30 rows.
